name: New jack swingbeat
desc: Teddy Riley machine swing: 808 kick syncopated around the one, huge snare-clap stack on 2&4, triplet-feel hats from elongation patterns (hh@2 hh - never .swing), open-hat barks. The 1989 uptown bounce, hits doubled at peak.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

snap.doc: snare stack level as fraction of kick

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] [~ bd ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*${snap}).room(.28), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.42 .22]*4").pan(cosine.range(.44,.58).slow(9)), s("[~ ~ ~ oh]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.42).lpf(6500).pan(.6), s("[sd@2 sd]*4").bank("RolandTR808").degradeBy(.85).gain(.16).pan(.42)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] [bd ~ bd ~]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.35), s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [[sd,cp] [sd,cp]]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*${snap}*1.1).room(.28), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.48 .26]*4").pan(cosine.range(.4,.62).slow(7)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[~ ~ ~ oh]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.5).lpf(7500).pan(.62), s("[sd@2 sd]*4").bank("RolandTR808").degradeBy(.78).gain(.18).pan(.4), s("cr ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.28).mask("<1 0 0 0>")).orbit(1).play()
